content.application_contract: Retain the fully opened parcel and loose torn wrapping on the same table after opening has finished. Active hand pulling, sorting parcels and arbitrary paper texture cannot substitute. Do not prescribe readable labels, unknown contents, an opener, theft, delivery history or exact elapsed time.
content.definition: Once a paper-wrapped parcel has been fully opened, torn wrapping remains on the table beside the open parcel, with loose separated paper edges resting on that same table.
content.en: Once a paper-wrapped parcel has been fully opened, torn wrapping remains on the table beside the open parcel, with loose separated paper edges resting on that same table.
content.ko: 종이로 감싼 소포를 완전히 여는 동작이 끝난 뒤 테이블 위에 찢어진 포장지가 남아 있다. 벌어진 소포 옆에서 분리된 종이 가장자리가 같은 테이블에 놓여 있다.

content.application_contract: Retain the completed bread-slicing event, bread crumbs on the cutting board, and the cut loaf and slice on that same board. Soil aggregates, noodle lettering, active cutting and a failed recipe cannot supply this relation. The still arrangement does not establish freshness, hygiene, a recipe or elapsed time.
content.definition: Bread crumbs remain on a cutting board after slicing one loaf has finished, beside the cut face of that loaf and a detached bread slice on the same board.
content.en: Bread crumbs remain on a cutting board after slicing one loaf has finished, beside the cut face of that loaf and a detached bread slice on the same board.
content.ko: 빵 한 덩어리를 자르는 동작이 끝난 뒤 도마 위에 빵 부스러기가 남아 있다. 잘린 빵의 단면과 떨어진 빵 조각은 같은 도마의 부스러기 옆에 놓여 있다.

content.application_contract: Retain the completed crossing's declared dog owner and the connected muddy pawprint trail on the same floor. A boot tread, an ongoing walking action or unrelated surface dirt is insufficient. The visible marks do not identify an animal species or individual independently, and do not require an additional visible animal.
content.definition: After a dog has finished crossing a floor, muddy pawprints remain on that floor as a trail of separate pad and toe deposits.
content.en: After a dog has finished crossing a floor, muddy pawprints remain on that floor as a trail of separate pad and toe deposits.
content.ko: 개가 바닥을 가로지르는 동작이 끝난 뒤 같은 바닥 위에 진흙 발자국이 남아 있다. 떨어진 발바닥 패드와 발가락 자국이 지나간 경로를 따라 이어진다.
